fine_trace.note: ZIP entry 'a/b' with uncompressed size 0 is parsed and added as a KZipFileEntry into directory 'a'. This zero-size file entry is the input-controlled state that triggers the bug.
When processing ZIP entry 'a/b/c/d', findOrCreate('a/b/c') is called. This is the outer findOrCreate call.
Outer findOrCreate('a/b/c') cannot find 'a/b/c', splits into left='a/b' and recursively calls findOrCreate('a/b').
Inner findOrCreate('a/b') looks up path 'a/b' and finds the zero-size KZipFileEntry 'b' in directory 'a'.

removeEntry is called on rootDir but 'b' lives in subdirectory 'a', not rootDir. The removal fails silently (logged: directory '/' has no entry with name 'b'). The entry is then deleted at line 483 while directory 'a' still holds the dangling pointer in its QHash.
Inner findOrCreate creates a new KArchiveDirectory named 'b' to replace the deleted file entry.
addEntry on directory 'a' finds the dangling pointer for 'b' still in QHash, considers it a duplicate, and deletes the newly created directory. Inner findOrCreate returns the now-freed pointer.
Outer findOrCreate uses the freed pointer as parent and calls parent->addEntry(). Accessing d (the private data member) of the freed KArchiveDirectory triggers heap-use-after-free READ 8.

via: freed pointer returned from inner findOrCreate as parent
